title: Medium stamina mead

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Medium stamina mead is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Medium stamina.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Medium stamina is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Cloudberries
• 10 Yellow mushroom
Six Medium stamina meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
Upon consumption, it restores 160 stamina over 2 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another stamina mead.
